sources.text: Park Shelters Sterling Ranch contains beautiful pocket parks spread out through the community. Park shelters are available to rent for private use. CAB-owned parks including the shelters and benches are available for rental. Playgrounds and grassy areas within any Park are not part of any Park rental. Pricing Park Shelter rentals: $15.00 per hour. Contact Us

sources.title: Trash & Recycling
sources.text: Trash & Recycling Our trash provider is Waste Connections. Waste Connections uses automated trucks to service Sterling Ranch and provide a more efficient trash and recycling experience. The new equipment features a side arm system that makes it easier to maneuver, ensures driver safety, and allows for faster service. Trash and recycling service fees are included in your monthly CAB bill. Pick Up Schedule Make sure to place bins outside by 7 am for trash collection. Containers for pickup may be placed on the street or alleyway on the morning of pickup and must be returned to an appropriately screened location by the end of the pickup day. Please be aware Sterling Ranch is home to various types of wildlife. Pro per trash cart storage is essential to the community and its inhabitants' safety. Extra or bulky items can be picked up by contacting Waste Connections at 303-288-2100. For Providence Village , trash is picked up weekly on Monday, and recycling is picked up every other Monday. For Ascent Village, trash is picked up weekly on Tuesday, and recycling is picked up every other Tuesday. For Prospect Village , trash is picked up weekly on Thursday, and recycling is picked up every other Thursday. Holiday Schedule Trash pickup will be delayed by one day for the following holidays: New Year's Day Memorial Day Independence Day Labor Day Thanksgiving Christmas Opt-In for Service Notifications Waste Connections also has an emergency phone call system that can notify residents in case of a delay or interruption in service. Service Notification Form New Homeowners Trash Cart Delivery Trash and recycling carts will be delivered to your home within ten days of closing.

sources.title: Water & Sewer
sources.text: Water & Sewer Sterling Ranch water is provided by Dominion Water and Sanitation District, a wholesale water district serving Northwest Douglas County. To meet water demands, Dominion has contracts for permanent water delivery from Aurora Water, the Water Infrastructure and Supply Efficiency (WISE) project, and Castle Rock. Today, our water from contracts with the City of Aurora is delivered directly to the Larry D. Moore Water Treatment Plant, a facility jointly funded by Dominion and Roxborough Water and Sanitation District. Sterling Ranch: A Water-Wise Community The Sterling Ranch Community Authority Board ( CAB ) is committed to providing our residents with the highest quality tap water and reliable services. Sterling Ranch is part of a new approach to creating a regionally integrated, comprehensive water system with a robust, reliable, and renewable water supply. Dominion Water and Sanitation District and Sterling Ranch CAB have constructed a state-of-the-art water system, including a joint treatment facility with Roxborough Water and Sanitation District, the Larry D. Moore Water Treatment Plant. It is the first treatment plant in Colorado to receive 100% of its initial disinfection credits from Ultra Violet ( UV ) light and provides Sterling Ranch with clean, healthy water. Dominion Water and Sanitation District has been awarded a Certificate of Appreciation for being a WaterSense Partner by practicing and promoting water efficiency. Maintenance Checklist for a Water-Efficient Home Water & Sewer Billing After closing on their homes, Sterling Ranch residents are automatically set up for water and sewer services. Residents receive their water and sewer bills in the mail monthly and are billed in arrears.

sources.text: Overlook Outdoor Pool 1 LowRes-114 2 LowRes-115 3 Overlook-Pool-Sterling-Ranch 4 DSC06555 5 DSC06620 Pool Hours T he pool is open Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day. Monday-Friday: 5:00 am - 9:00 am: Lap Swim Tuesday & Thursday - 7:00 am - 8:45 am: Pool cleaning and maintenance. 9:00 am - 8:45 pm: Open Swim (Lifeguards on duty 9:00 am - 8:45 pm) School back in session: Lifeguard hours are 4:00 pm - 8:45 pm. Each CAB Resident household is permitted up to six (6) guests per day. If the pool is not at capacity, additional guests beyond six (6) will be permitted for a fee of $5.00 per guest. CAB Residents are encouraged to call and verify capacity before arrival. Guests MUST be accompanied by the CAB Resident, who will provide the guest passes at all times during their use of the Clubhouse and Pool facilities. If the resident does not accompany guests, they will be asked to leave. Concessions Concessions are available for purchase on the pool deck. Concessions are provided by Agora Market. Open daily 9 am - 7 pm during pool season. Rules to Remember There is no glass in the pool area at any time. No running or diving. Utilize swim diapers for all incontinent persons. Inflatables must be circular, clear, and less than 42" in diameter. Lifeguards have final discretion on all pool rules. sources.title: Water Billing
sources.text: Water Billing Sterling Ranch residents are automatically set up for water and sewer after closing on their homes. Residents receive their water and sewer bills in the mail monthly and are billed in arrears. American Conservation and Billing Solutions ( AmCoBi) administers the monthly water bill each month. Questions? AmCoBi's Client Care Services Team is available to assist you with questions or concerns regarding your water bill. Please contact them at: Toll-free: 1-833-SRCAB-40 or (833) 772-2240 E-mail: ClientCare@AmCoBi.com Payment Options: Please register your account through Utility Hawk ( https://srcab.utilityhawk.us ). Point your Web browser to: https://srcab.utilityhawk.us/login Select the "Pay Online" link on the home page. Follow the instructions. Your online account allows you to choose the best payment options for you, check your account balance and activity, and elect to receive your water bill electronically (eBill). AmCoBi's ePay service allows you to pay your bill online with an automatic withdrawal from your checking/savings account (ACH) free of charge. You can also use a debit or credit card with a processing fee of 2.95%, charged by Paymentus, the payment processing provider. Report a Water Concern If you have concerns or questions about the water in your home, please complete the Report a Water Concern Form and a staff member will be in touch with you. sources.title: Rent the Facility
sources.text: Rent the Facility The Overlook Clubhouse is an excellent venue to host your event. It provides a perfect location and a fantastic atmosphere for any occasion. The clubhouse is an ideal gathering space for organizing events, parties, community meetings, activities, picnics, groups, and clubs. The Member Services team at the Overlook Clubhouse will assist you in making your private party an event for you and your guests to remember! Great Hall The Overlook Clubhouse offers a Great Hall with a warming kitchen, an outdoor deck, and an indoor/outdoor fireplace. This space can be reserved for private use. However, when not reserved, the Great Hall, kitchen, and outdoor deck are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Please note that all members of the private rental must remain in the rented space, and additional facility access will not be permitted. Hourly Pricing $100.00 per hour with a 2-hour minimum. All rentals include the use of the indoor space and balcony. A refundable security deposit of 250.00 will also be due upon rental confirmation. Outdoor Pavilions The clubhouse has two outdoor, covered pavilions to reserve for private parties. The pavilions are available on a first-come, first-served basis when not reserved for private use. Each household can reserve one of the outdoor pavilions once per day, with no more than two rentals per calendar month. All members of the private rental must stay in the rented space. Additional facility access is not permitted. North Pavilion Larger space that includes an outdoor fireplace and convertible picnic tables South Pavilion Smaller space that includes an outdoor BBQ grill and two picnic tables Hourly Pricing $25 per hour.

sources.text: All categories Home - FAQs Water Water Communication Retrofit Design Review Compliance Overlook Clubhouse Pool Frequently Asked Questions Water 6 All Content What does the monthly fixed fee include? The water rate billing structure includes a fixed monthly water service base fee and a residential usage charge. This base fee covers the cost of the water and sewer utility’s fixed and operating costs before any service is provided. The residential usage charge is based on tiered rates and are variable based upon use. Rates and Fees are established annually by the Community Authority Board (CAB) Board. The CAB rates are generally higher than many of the neighboring utilities and does not include a mill levy component that many neighboring utilities use to fund capital projects. However, many of these neighboring providers are older, established enterprises who rely on nonrenewable water supplies. The CAB rates are based on developing a renewable water system from inception. It is likely water rates for neighboring utilities will continue to rise at a faster rate than those of the CAB due to the costs of obtaining and developing renewable water supplies. Water How are my indoor water usage tiers established? A homeowner’s individualized indoor water budget is structured on an average winter consumption ( AWC ) to determine the tier 1 threshold. The AWC is determined by averaging the customer’s actual indoor water use for the months of December, January, and February. The AWC is reset annually to allow for life changes. The tier 1 minimum threshold for residential homes is a minimum of 4,000 gallons per month and a maximum of 6,000 gallons per month. Accounts without an AWC history will be assigned 6,000 gallons per month as an initial AWC .

sources.text: Water How do I troubleshoot your water meter when you have no water? Valves - Gen 1 These valves require the smart home system to be online and functioning to open and close the valves. To troubleshoot we recommend the following: Make sure the smart home system is online; if not, use https://lumiere.technology/knowledge-base/category/STEWARD/ Submit a ticket with our team at https://lumiere.technology/open-a-ticket/ Water Valves - Gen 2 These valves can easily be opened and closed manually. To troubleshoot, we recommend the following: Click the blue power button on the Dome Valve 1 time. 1 click will cause the arm to turn and open the water supply (see Gen 2 Valves #2 for that power button) If this button does not cause the arm to turn, pull the silver pin on the device and manually move the arm (see Gen 2 Valves #3 for that pin) For additional help submit a ticket at https://lumiere.technology/open-a-ticket/ Water Why are outdoor water rates slightly higher than indoor water rates? The water rates are structured to recover system costs. Outdoor water rates were designed to encourage water-wise irrigation practices. Outdoor water use increases the demand on our water system, and therefore the operational costs of our facilities. Additionally, when water is used outdoors it is fully consumed and not returned to the system. Water How do I move into higher tiers each month? The first tier of fee rates per 1,000 gallons applies to the use of up to 100% of the customer’s water budget. The tier fee rate per 1,000 gallons for use over 100% of the water budget increases based upon the amount over 100% that is used by that customer.

sources.title: FAQs - CivicPlus.CMS.FAQ
sources.text: All categories Home - FAQs Water Water Communication Retrofit Design Review Compliance Overlook Clubhouse Pool Frequently Asked Questions Water 6 All Content What does the monthly fixed fee include? The water rate billing structure includes a fixed monthly water service base fee and a residential usage charge. This base fee covers the cost of the water and sewer utility’s fixed and operating costs before any service is provided. The residential usage charge is based on tiered rates and are variable based upon use. Rates and Fees are established annually by the Community Authority Board (CAB) Board. The CAB rates are generally higher than many of the neighboring utilities and does not include a mill levy component that many neighboring utilities use to fund capital projects. However, many of these neighboring providers are older, established enterprises who rely on nonrenewable water supplies. The CAB rates are based on developing a renewable water system from inception. It is likely water rates for neighboring utilities will continue to rise at a faster rate than those of the CAB due to the costs of obtaining and developing renewable water supplies. Water How are my indoor water usage tiers established? A homeowner’s individualized indoor water budget is structured on an average winter consumption ( AWC ) to determine the tier 1 threshold. The AWC is determined by averaging the customer’s actual indoor water use for the months of December, January, and February. The AWC is reset annually to allow for life changes. The tier 1 minimum threshold for residential homes is a minimum of 4,000 gallons per month and a maximum of 6,000 gallons per month. Accounts without an AWC history will be assigned 6,000 gallons per month as an initial AWC .

sources.text: All categories Home - FAQs Water Water Communication Retrofit Design Review Compliance Overlook Clubhouse Pool Frequently Asked Questions Overlook Clubhouse Pool 9 All Content What are the pool rules? All swimmers must check in at the front desk with their membership card or a photo of it. There is no pool entrance from the side gates. Children under the age of 11 years must be accompanied and actively supervised by a parent, guardian, or if authorized by a parent/guardian, another individual of 15 years of age or older, while using the Clubhouse or Pool. Swimming any time where a lifeguard is not on duty is at the swimmer's sole risk. Lifeguards may not be on duty when temperatures are below 65 degrees and inclement weather is present. All users must take a cleansing shower before entering the pool. Showering after using the pool is recommended. Appropriate swimwear must be worn at all times. Street clothing (basketball shorts, jean/denim materials, cargo shorts), undergarments, sports bras, or similar attire is prohibited in the pool. White t-shirts or tank-tops are permitted in the pool if worn over appropriate swim attire. Pool staff will make the final determination if swimwear is appropriate. Nudity is strictly prohibited. Non-swimmers must be accompanied by a swimmer in the water and be within an arm's reach at all times. Glass containers are prohibited in the pool and pool areas. Food and beverages are permitted on the pool deck. Food and beverages are not permitted in the pool. To avoid spilling food or beverages into the pool, please keep them at your chair or table. Users who are ill, have experienced vomiting or diarrhea in the past 24 hours, have open sores, or ear/nasal discharge should not use the pool.

sources.text: Swim diapers must be worn by all incontinent swimmers. Horseplay, running, diving into the pool, and hanging/swinging/pulling on aquatic equipment or features is prohibited. Repeat violators will be asked to leave the pool. Lane lines, stairs, and railings are installed to assist and guide pool users. Standing, hanging from, or sitting on these items is prohibited. When lap lanes are present, those areas are for lap swimming and water walking only. During busy times, lap swimmers may be asked to share lanes, circle swim, or limit swim time to ensure all have an opportunity to use the facilities. The pool deck is reserved for walking, safety, and emergency purposes. No obstruction of any kind will be permitted in this area. Inflatable pool toys, flotation aids, or similar items are only allowed under the following conditions: Only transparent, circular inflatables no larger than 42 inches in diameter, infant inflatables, water wings with an attached chest piece, and pool noodles are permitted in the pool. Mesh infant inflatables may be no larger than 33 inches by 38 inches. Pool mattresses or other inflatables are prohibited. Users with noncompliant inflatables or flotation devices will be asked to remove them from the pool. Personal sound equipment, such as stereos or wireless speakers, are permitted as long as they do not disrupt others' enjoyment of the pool. If any complaints are received, Users will be asked to turn down their music, use headphones, or upon repeated complaint, asked to turn off the device or leave the pool. The pool must be cleared during thunder and lightning storms or other inclement weather events that present danger to Users.

sources.text: The pool will be cleared if lightning strikes within 10 miles of the pool, or at the discretion of Clubhouse or Pool Staff. All users must follow staff directions and safety instructions. Staff will determine when it is safe to reopen the pool. Chemicals are used to ensure a sanitary and safe water environment. Conditions are tested and documented on a regular basis. If unacceptable conditions occur, including a vomiting or fecal event, staff will determine if the pool must be closed to preserve the health, safety, and well-being of all users. Chemicals used in the pool may damage swimwear. CAB is not responsible for any such damage. CAB furniture in the pool area shall not be removed. Users may bring additional, portable lounge chairs, umbrellas, or other similar items to the pool area, provided they do not present a safety concern or unreasonably interfere with others' use and enjoyment of the pool as determined by staff. The clubhouse lifeguard vendor will offer private swim lessons throughout the Summer. Each session days, times, and pricing will be coordinated directly through the vendor. Private swim lesson sign-ups will available on a first-come-first-served basis subject to instructor availability. Overlook Clubhouse Pool Can I bring a guest to the pool? Yes!

sources.text: Each household receives 25 guest passes each calendar year linked to your CIVICREC account. Each CAB Resident household is permitted up to six (6) guests per day. If the Clubhouse and Pool is not at capacity, additional guests beyond six (6) will be permitted for a fee of $5.00 per guest. CAB Residents are encouraged to call and verify capacity before arrival. Guests MUST be accompanied by the CAB Resident providing the guest passes at all times during their use of Clubhouse and Pool facilities. If guests are not accompanied by the resident, they will be asked to leave. When you arrive with your guests, please indicate the number of guest and we will deduct the passes from your account. Overlook Clubhouse Pool Can a caregiver take my kids to the pool? You can purchase a caregiver pass for $300.00 for the calendar year, listing up to four names to use the caregiver pass. ID will be required to use the pass and the individual must be with those they are giving care for. Only one person can use the caregiver pass at a time. Overlook Clubhouse Pool What is the capacity of the pool? 169 individuals are permitted at one time. Overlook Clubhouse Pool Will lap swim be available? Yes, each morning, Monday through Friday from 5:00a -7:00a is reserved for lap swim. We will also have at least one lap lane available during open swim times. Overlook Clubhouse Pool Can I reserve the pool for a party? Unfortunately, the pool is not available for rental. There are other great spaces at the Overlook to reserve for private parties! Overlook Clubhouse Pool Are reservations required? No. On April 16, 2021, Douglas County opted out of the Tri-County Health public order, thus allowing all businesses to operate at 100% capacity.

All users must follow staff directions and safety instructions. Staff will determine when it is safe to reopen the pool. Chemicals are used to ensure a sanitary and safe water environment. Conditions are tested and documented on a regular basis. If unacceptable conditions occur, including a vomiting or fecal event, staff will determine if the pool must be closed to preserve the health, safety, and well-being of all users. Chemicals used in the pool may damage swimwear. CAB is not responsible for any such damage. CAB furniture in the pool area shall not be removed. Users may bring additional, portable lounge chairs, umbrellas, or other similar items to the pool area, provided they do not present a safety concern or unreasonably interfere with others' use and enjoyment of the pool as determined by staff. Overlook Clubhouse Pool What are the hours of operation? Monday-Friday: 5:00 am - 7:00 am Lap Swim Tuesday & Thursday - 7:00 am - 8:45 am: Pool CLOSED for cleaning and maintenance. 9:00 am - 8:45 pm: Open Swim (Lifeguards on duty 9:00 am - 8:45 pm) School back in session: Lifeguard hours are 4:00 pm - 8:45 pm. Saturday: 9:00 am - 8:45 pm (Lifeguards on duty 9:00 am - 7:45 pm) Sunday: 9:00 am - 8:45 pm (Lifeguards on duty 9:00 am - 7:45 pm) Overlook Clubhouse Pool Will swim lessons be offered? Yes! The clubhouse lifeguard vendor will offer private swim lessons throughout the Summer. Each session days, times, and pricing will be coordinated directly through the vendor. Private swim lesson sign-ups will available on a first-come-first-served basis subject to instructor availability. Overlook Clubhouse Pool Can I bring a guest to the pool? Yes!

sources.text: Each household receives 25 guest passes each calendar year linked to your CIVICREC account. Each CAB Resident household is permitted up to six (6) guests per day. If the Clubhouse and Pool is not at capacity, additional guests beyond six (6) will be permitted for a fee of $5.00 per guest. CAB Residents are encouraged to call and verify capacity before arrival. Guests MUST be accompanied by the CAB Resident providing the guest passes at all times during their use of Clubhouse and Pool facilities. If guests are not accompanied by the resident, they will be asked to leave. When you arrive with your guests, please indicate the number of guest and we will deduct the passes from your account. Overlook Clubhouse Pool Can a caregiver take my kids to the pool? You can purchase a caregiver pass for $300.00 for the calendar year, listing up to four names to use the caregiver pass. ID will be required to use the pass and the individual must be with those they are giving care for. Only one person can use the caregiver pass at a time. Overlook Clubhouse Pool What is the capacity of the pool? 169 individuals are permitted at one time. Overlook Clubhouse Pool Will lap swim be available? Yes, each morning, Monday through Friday from 5:00a -7:00a is reserved for lap swim. We will also have at least one lap lane available during open swim times. Overlook Clubhouse Pool Can I reserve the pool for a party? Unfortunately, the pool is not available for rental. There are other great spaces at the Overlook to reserve for private parties! Overlook Clubhouse Pool Are reservations required? No. On April 16, 2021, Douglas County opted out of the Tri-County Health public order, thus allowing all businesses to operate at 100% capacity.

sources.text: All categories Home - FAQs Water Water Communication Retrofit Design Review Compliance Overlook Clubhouse Pool Frequently Asked Questions Overlook Clubhouse Pool 9 All Content What are the pool rules? All swimmers must check in at the front desk with their membership card or a photo of it. There is no pool entrance from the side gates. Children under the age of 11 years must be accompanied and actively supervised by a parent, guardian, or if authorized by a parent/guardian, another individual of 15 years of age or older, while using the Clubhouse or Pool. Swimming any time where a lifeguard is not on duty is at the swimmer's sole risk. Lifeguards may not be on duty when temperatures are below 65 degrees and inclement weather is present. All users must take a cleansing shower before entering the pool. Showering after using the pool is recommended. Appropriate swimwear must be worn at all times. Street clothing (basketball shorts, jean/denim materials, cargo shorts), undergarments, sports bras, or similar attire is prohibited in the pool. White t-shirts or tank-tops are permitted in the pool if worn over appropriate swim attire. Pool staff will make the final determination if swimwear is appropriate. Nudity is strictly prohibited. Non-swimmers must be accompanied by a swimmer in the water and be within an arm's reach at all times. Glass containers are prohibited in the pool and pool areas. Food and beverages are permitted on the pool deck. Food and beverages are not permitted in the pool. To avoid spilling food or beverages into the pool, please keep them at your chair or table. Users who are ill, have experienced vomiting or diarrhea in the past 24 hours, have open sores, or ear/nasal discharge should not use the pool.

sources.title: FAQs - CivicPlus.CMS.FAQ
sources.text: Swim diapers must be worn by all incontinent swimmers. Horseplay, running, diving into the pool, and hanging/swinging/pulling on aquatic equipment or features is prohibited. Repeat violators will be asked to leave the pool. Lane lines, stairs, and railings are installed to assist and guide pool users. Standing, hanging from, or sitting on these items is prohibited. When lap lanes are present, those areas are for lap swimming and water walking only. During busy times, lap swimmers may be asked to share lanes, circle swim, or limit swim time to ensure all have an opportunity to use the facilities. The pool deck is reserved for walking, safety, and emergency purposes. No obstruction of any kind will be permitted in this area. Inflatable pool toys, flotation aids, or similar items are only allowed under the following conditions: Only transparent, circular inflatables no larger than 42 inches in diameter, infant inflatables, water wings with an attached chest piece, and pool noodles are permitted in the pool. Mesh infant inflatables may be no larger than 33 inches by 38 inches. Pool mattresses or other inflatables are prohibited. Users with noncompliant inflatables or flotation devices will be asked to remove them from the pool. Personal sound equipment, such as stereos or wireless speakers, are permitted as long as they do not disrupt others' enjoyment of the pool. If any complaints are received, Users will be asked to turn down their music, use headphones, or upon repeated complaint, asked to turn off the device or leave the pool. The pool must be cleared during thunder and lightning storms or other inclement weather events that present danger to Users.

sources.text: All categories Home - FAQs Water Water Communication Retrofit Design Review Compliance Overlook Clubhouse Pool Frequently Asked Questions Home - FAQs 6 All Content How do I submit an application for Design Review? Please submit your completed application digitally via residentsubmit@sterlingranchcab.com Design Review Committee (DRC) meetings are scheduled for the first and third Thursday during the months of March through September, and the first Thursday during October through February. Applications and forms can be downloaded on the DRC Applications web page . Completed applications must be received via residentsubmit@sterlingranchcab.com by end of business day on the Friday prior to a DRC meeting to be reviewed at that meeting. If it is not received by end of business on the Friday before the meeting, it will be put on the following meeting’s agenda. If a fee is required, mail the physical check made out to Sterling Ranch Community Authority along with a copy of your application to Sterling Ranch DRC, 8155 Piney River Avenue, Suite 150, Littleton, CO 80125. Recurring credit card payments with Smartstreet are valid for one year or when your credit card expires, whichever is sooner. At that time, you must renew your payment with Smartstreet, it does not happen automatically. If you have recurring payments with Smartstreet and your assessment amount changes, you must update your payment information with Smartstreet as it doesn’t happen automatically. sources.text: If you haven’t signed up to get access to the Overlook Clubhouse, complete the Resident Amenity Form online today! **For homeowners who registered for the Overlook Clubhouse prior to its opening in October 2020 should have received the email to complete account setup already. If you have not received the email or your link is expired, please contact the Overlook Clubhouse at 720-728-7257 or email recreation@sterlingranchcab.com and a staff member will assist you.** This account and password are for the new CIVICREC system and will be used for registering for events, reserving time to use the fitness center, purchasing fitness classes, additional guest passes, and more! Follow the instructions listed below to complete your account setup. How to Finish Your Online Account Setup Open the email. You will have a username (your email provided) and a temporary password to log in. Select TO LOGIN AND CHANGE YOUR PASSWORD NOW CLICK HERE. You will be redirected to the new CIVICREC Website. Once logged in, select ACCOUNT in the top lefthand corner. Select the pencil icon next to your name. In the lower-left corner, select RESET CIVICREC PASSWORD. You will be prompted to confirm that you would like to reset the password. A password reset link will be sent to your email. Follow the instructions to reset your password. Registering for Events & Programs Navigate to the Community Calendar . Click on the event that interests you. Click "More Details" to view the full event description, event cost, suggested ages, and registration links. Review the event details and confirm if an RSVP or program registration is required. If required, a link to register on the right-hand column will say "Register Now" Follow the registration prompts.

This base fee covers the cost of the water and sewer utility’s fixed and operating costs before any service is provided.

sources.text: The residential usage charge is based on tiered rates and are variable based upon use. Rates and Fees are established annually by the Community Authority Board (CAB) Board. The CAB rates are generally higher than many of the neighboring utilities and does not include a mill levy component that many neighboring utilities use to fund capital projects. However, many of these neighboring providers are older, established enterprises who rely on nonrenewable water supplies. The CAB rates are based on developing a renewable water system from inception. It is likely water rates for neighboring utilities will continue to rise at a faster rate than those of the CAB due to the costs of obtaining and developing renewable water supplies. Water How are my indoor water usage tiers established? A homeowner’s individualized indoor water budget is structured on an average winter consumption ( AWC ) to determine the tier 1 threshold. The AWC is determined by averaging the customer’s actual indoor water use for the months of December, January, and February. The AWC is reset annually to allow for life changes. The tier 1 minimum threshold for residential homes is a minimum of 4,000 gallons per month and a maximum of 6,000 gallons per month. Accounts without an AWC history will be assigned 6,000 gallons per month as an initial AWC . Water How do I troubleshoot your water meter when you have no water? Valves - Gen 1 These valves require the smart home system to be online and functioning to open and close the valves.

The first tier of fee rates per 1,000 gallons applies to the use of up to 100% of the customer’s water budget. The tier fee rate per 1,000 gallons for use over 100% of the water budget increases based upon the amount over 100% that is used by that customer. Water used during the establishment period (45 days following the installation of turf and plant material) will be billed at the first tier fee rate, and will not count against the water budget. sources.text: Once the Siemens technician arrives at your home, the equipment upgrades should take approximately 2 hours. Water Communication Retrofit Will I be able to use internet while the upgrade is taking place? The technician will need to shut off a circuit breaker to perform the necessary electrical work. If your internet is utilizing that same circuit breaker, you will not be able to access the internet for approximately 45 minutes while electrical work is being performed. Because of this, we strongly recommend not scheduling critical tasks that will require internet access or VoIP phone use during your service window. Water Communication Retrofit What can I do to prepare? In order to minimize the time required, prior to the technician’s arrival please clear adequate space (at least 3 square feet) around your water meter panel, electrical breaker box, and STEWARD equipment. This equipment is typically located in the basement. If you do not have a basement, the equipment is typically located in the garage. Water Communication Retrofit What information should I be ready to share? If you have changed the default login to your CenturyLink ONT /modem’s admin portal, please be prepared to provide that information as well. If you would prefer not to share this information, please be prepared to input your credentials for the technician at the necessary times. If you do not know your STEWARD login credentials, visit the Lumiere website . Water Communication Retrofit Why are you removing the virtual private network (VPN) hardware? The virtual private network ( VPN ) hardware was previously necessary to ensure proper encryption of water meter information during transmission to the water billing system. This is no longer the case as we are now able to use an alternate encryption method.

sources.text: Application fees can be paid via check made payable to Sterling Ranch CAB, or via credit/debit card. Please contact the team at the Resident Resource Center for assistance paying via credit/debit card. Checks can be mailed or dropped off to Sterling Ranch CAB, 8220 Piney River Ave, Littleton, CO 80125. Design Review After I receive my approval, can I modify or deviate from my application slightly? Approval was granted based on the information the homeowner provided to the committee on the application. A new Design Review Application will need to be submitted should a homeowner need to make any changes to the original application. (EXCEPT for plant material selection as long as it is for water to water same) Design Review How long does the Design Review Process take? The Design Review Committee has up to 30 days to review a submittal from the date a completed submittal package was received at the Design Review Committee meeting. If you have not been notified in writing by the 31st day after the meeting, the submittal is deemed to be denied. It is the responsibility of the applicant to contact the Design Review Committee to determine the status of the submittal. Design Review How many days do I have to install my rear yard? The rear yard landscape must be completed within 120 days following your closing. A Winter Deferral Period for completion of rear yard planting is granted for closings from November 1 to April 30. Design Review Am I allowed to make changes to my grading or drainage? The DRC does not evaluate changes to grading or drainage. Applicants are to seek approval from the County and/or other appropriate governing bodies. The DRC is not responsible in any way for changes made to grading and/or drainage while installing landscaping or other improvements.

Sterling Ranch collaborated with Denver Botanic Gardens to research plantings that flourish in Colorado’s semi-arid climate. The concerted research effort trialed planting for water sustainability and resiliency and took form as a test garden planted on the property that was maintained and observed for three years. The recommend plant list is a great start to understanding the Sterling Ranch planting palette, but the Design Review Committee will review additional plant material requests. Design Review Am I limited to the landscape contractors on the Pre-Approved Landscaper List? No, you may work with a landscaper of your choice, but that professional landscaper will need to meet with our Architectural and Community Standards Director to become certified and approved. The approval process includes education on Sterling Ranch Water Demand Management Initiatives and the Design Review process. Please note, inclusion on this list does not constitute the CAB’s endorsement of any of these companies. Learn more about Design Review Compliance Are there any guidelines I need to follow to have a temporary dumpster or a storage pod at my house? Please submit an Application for General Architectural Improvements to the Design Review Committee for approval. Include with the application timeframe for dumpster or storage pod to be at property. Please note, dumpsters and storage pods must be placed in your driveway and are not allowed on a public right-of-way per Douglas County officials. Compliance What is the guideline for having a recreational vehicle at my home? The maximum amount of time a Recreational Vehicle is allowed to be parked is three overnights (e.g., 72 hours) during any 7-day period for loading, delivery, and maintenance. Periodic movement of the vehicle for the purpose of circumventing this standard shall not qualify the vehicle for an exception from this standard. Please refer to the Residential Property Owner Guidebook, Article VI General Standards for further regulation details. Compliance Do I need to submit my paint colors even if I am painting my home the exact same colors? DRC approval is required, even if re-painting is being done with the same colors as the original or previous paint color. Please refer to the Residential Property Owner Guidebook, Article VI General Standards for further regulation details. Compliance Do trampolines and play equipment require approval? DRC approval is required. Trampolines will be considered based on size, height, color, relationship to size of lot, relationship to landscaping, setbacks from property lines, method of installation, and proposed safety netting. Trampolines are required to be anchored per manufacturer specifications.

sources.text: Compliance Is it okay for me to access the open space to do improvements on my property? No, all access to your property must be from the street side at the front of your home. Accessing the property through another lot, open space, parks, or landscaped tracts is prohibited. Please refer to the Residential Property Owner Guidebook, Section IV. Landscaping Standards. Compliance What can I do about a barking dog or a neighbor that does not clean up after their animals on a regular basis? If you are trying to solve a problem with a barking dog or clean up after a pet, please start with communicating your concern to the pet owner or contact the following county authorities: Douglas County Animal Services, 303-660-7529, 7:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m. Sheriff’s Department Dispatch, 303-660-7500 (After 6 p.m. if an animal problem requires immediate attention). Compliance Overlook Clubhouse Pool 9 All Content What are the pool rules? All swimmers must check in at the front desk with their membership card or a photo of it. There is no pool entrance from the side gates. Children under the age of 11 years must be accompanied and actively supervised by a parent, guardian, or if authorized by a parent/guardian, another individual of 15 years of age or older, while using the Clubhouse or Pool. Swimming any time where a lifeguard is not on duty is at the swimmer's sole risk. Lifeguards may not be on duty when temperatures are below 65 degrees and inclement weather is present. All users must take a cleansing shower before entering the pool. Showering after using the pool is recommended. Appropriate swimwear must be worn at all times. Street clothing (basketball shorts, jean/denim materials, cargo shorts), undergarments, sports bras, or similar attire is prohibited in the pool.

sources.text: White t-shirts or tank-tops are permitted in the pool if worn over appropriate swim attire. Pool staff will make the final determination if swimwear is appropriate. Nudity is strictly prohibited. Non-swimmers must be accompanied by a swimmer in the water and be within an arm's reach at all times. Glass containers are prohibited in the pool and pool areas. Food and beverages are permitted on the pool deck. Food and beverages are not permitted in the pool. To avoid spilling food or beverages into the pool, please keep them at your chair or table. Users who are ill, have experienced vomiting or diarrhea in the past 24 hours, have open sores, or ear/nasal discharge should not use the pool. Swim diapers must be worn by all incontinent swimmers. Horseplay, running, diving into the pool, and hanging/swinging/pulling on aquatic equipment or features is prohibited. Repeat violators will be asked to leave the pool. Lane lines, stairs, and railings are installed to assist and guide pool users. Standing, hanging from, or sitting on these items is prohibited. When lap lanes are present, those areas are for lap swimming and water walking only. During busy times, lap swimmers may be asked to share lanes, circle swim, or limit swim time to ensure all have an opportunity to use the facilities. The pool deck is reserved for walking, safety, and emergency purposes. No obstruction of any kind will be permitted in this area. Inflatable pool toys, flotation aids, or similar items are only allowed under the following conditions: Only transparent, circular inflatables no larger than 42 inches in diameter, infant inflatables, water wings with an attached chest piece, and pool noodles are permitted in the pool. Mesh infant inflatables may be no larger than 33 inches by 38 inches.

sources.text: Pool mattresses or other inflatables are prohibited. Users with noncompliant inflatables or flotation devices will be asked to remove them from the pool. Personal sound equipment, such as stereos or wireless speakers, are permitted as long as they do not disrupt others' enjoyment of the pool. If any complaints are received, Users will be asked to turn down their music, use headphones, or upon repeated complaint, asked to turn off the device or leave the pool. The pool must be cleared during thunder and lightning storms or other inclement weather events that present danger to Users. The pool will be cleared if lightning strikes within 10 miles of the pool, or at the discretion of Clubhouse or Pool Staff. All users must follow staff directions and safety instructions. Staff will determine when it is safe to reopen the pool. Chemicals are used to ensure a sanitary and safe water environment. Conditions are tested and documented on a regular basis. If unacceptable conditions occur, including a vomiting or fecal event, staff will determine if the pool must be closed to preserve the health, safety, and well-being of all users. Chemicals used in the pool may damage swimwear. CAB is not responsible for any such damage. CAB furniture in the pool area shall not be removed. Users may bring additional, portable lounge chairs, umbrellas, or other similar items to the pool area, provided they do not present a safety concern or unreasonably interfere with others' use and enjoyment of the pool as determined by staff. sources.text: 8155 Piney River Ave #150, Littleton CO 80125 Billing Inquiries: Clientcare@amcobi.com Welcome, Sterling Ranch residents, to the most advanced water conservation community in Colorado. We are committed to conserving water and being good stewards of the land. Our innovative water solutions to conserve water community-wide will help residents with water costs long term. You play a part in this important conservation and we need your help. As you get your rear yards planted, we understand the need for an Establishment Period to promote healthy root system growth. This Rear Yard Establishment Period is a one-time only, 45-day period following the date of completion of your rear landscaping. Outdoor water used during this Rear Yard Establishment Period will be billed at the most affordable water cost, which is the “Tier One” water rate. In addition, the amount of water delivered during the Rear Yard Establishment Period will not count against your overall Water Budget. Please let the Community Authority Board know of your need for the Rear Yard Establishment Period water rates by completing the form below so that we make sure to ensure proper billing. This form can be mailed to the CAB at the address listed above or emailed to Clientcare@amcobi.com Name Address Phone Number Email Address Closing Date Account Number DATE OF TURF/VEGETATION COMPLETION OWNER SIGNATURE DATE CONDITIONS: 1. Due to the time needed to process this Notification, Tier One credits will be applied one time to your water bill at the end of the 45-day period. 2. Owners have 1-year to apply for Establishment Period credits. The 1-year period will start on the 120th day following Closing.

sources.text: 8155 Piney River Avenue, #150 | Littleton Colorado 80125 submit@sterlingranchdrc.com Calculating Outdoor Water Usage for a Landscape Design Every home in Sterling Ranch has an outdoor water use budget based on the overall lot square footage. For water offered at the lowest, Tier 1 billing rate, see Table 1 below. • 30% of the outdoor water budget is used by the builder for the front yard irrigation • 70% of the overall outdoor water budget remains to irrigate the backyard plants • It is recommended to not design a landscape that requires 100% of the budget to allow for seasons with high temperatures and little precipitation conditions so that the Tier 1 billing rate is not exceeded. Calculate Outdoor Water Use Determine which plants in the plan are High Water, Moderate Water, and Low Water usage. Local nursery websites are a great resource to help understand the water needs of plants. Sod, vegetable gardens, and water features are always high water usage. Then, begin calculating the irrigated square footage (sf) of the plant by using the sf of each plant at full growth. See calculations below for some typical plant sizes. Trees are the exception to the rule. As water is only delivered around the trunk of the tree, use a 3’ diameter irrigated area for calculations. -- 1 of 2 -- 8155 Piney River Avenue, #150 | Littleton Colorado 80125 submit@sterlingranchdrc.com High Water Use: plant irrigated sf x 20 gals/sf = Total gallons needed for the season Moderate Water Use: plant irrigated sf x 10 gals/sf = Total gallons needed for the season Low Water Use: plant irrigated sf x 6 gals/sf = Total gallons needed for the season For example, a Moderate Water use plant at 2’ diameter full growth: 3.142 sf irrigated area x 10 gals/sf = 31.42 gallons needed for the season.

Shed footprint maximum is 150 square feet. In general, backyard utility sheds should not exceed an overall height of 8’-6”. If shed footprint is 150 square feet or less and the roof pitch is at a slope of 4:12 and the 8’-6” height is exceeded, the DRC will evaluate on a case by case basis for approval. Utilities to a backyard utility shed must be underground. Backyard utility sheds must be screened with landscape plantings that at full growth reach a minimum of half the shed wall height. Evergreen plantings are strongly recommended for four season screening and visual interest. Backyard utility sheds are strongly recommended to be located outside easements. No variances will be granted on high visibility lots, icon lots or enhanced lots. sources.title: Trash Screening
sources.text: The information on this sheet is NOT all inclusive of all Community Design Guidelines or Covenants. Please review all Community governing documents prior to planning any modifications to the exterior of your home. 8220 Piney River Avenue | Littleton, Colorado 80125 | www.sterlingranchcab.com TRASH ENCLOSURE/SCREENING Trash bins need to be kept within garages or in an approved enclosure. Keep the neighborhood beautiful and completely screen unsightly trash and recycling bins from view from the street, the sidewalk or any adjacent property. DRC approval is NOT REQUIRED if ALL of the following conditions are met: • The trash enclosure/screening is installed behind the wing fence in the side yard (may not be on an exposed corner side), • Must be attached to the side of the house, • Has a minimum setback from the side property line of 5 feet, • Is not located within any easement(s), • Is constructed of top-grade cedar or high grade Trex material or an equivalent in a color complementary to the home or painted to match the fence stain color of Sherwin Williams #3002 “Belvedere Tan,” and • May not exceed 4’-6” in height from ground level at any point. Any trash enclosure/screening not meeting ALL of these conditions must be submitted for DRC approval. Trash and Recycling enclosures will be considered based on size, height, color, rela- tionship to size of lot, relationship to landscaping, and setbacks from property lines. Material, style and color, including roofing, need to be appropriate for the architectural style of the home. Please be aware Sterling Ranch is home to various different types of wildlife! Proper trash cart storage is important to the safety of the community and those that inhabit it.

sources.text: All categories Home - FAQs Water Water Communication Retrofit Design Review Compliance Overlook Clubhouse Pool Frequently Asked Questions Home - FAQs 6 All Content How do I submit an application for Design Review? Please submit your completed application digitally via residentsubmit@sterlingranchcab.com Design Review Committee (DRC) meetings are scheduled for the first and third Thursday during the months of March through September, and the first Thursday during October through February. Applications and forms can be downloaded on the DRC Applications web page . Completed applications must be received via residentsubmit@sterlingranchcab.com by end of business day on the Friday prior to a DRC meeting to be reviewed at that meeting. If it is not received by end of business on the Friday before the meeting, it will be put on the following meeting’s agenda. If a fee is required, mail the physical check made out to Sterling Ranch Community Authority along with a copy of your application to Sterling Ranch DRC, 8155 Piney River Avenue, Suite 150, Littleton, CO 80125. Home - FAQs How do I pay my bill? Water & Sewer Bill: Residents of Sterling Ranch receive a monthly water & sewer bill in the mail each month. To view and pay your monthly water & sewer bill follow the following instructions: You have on-line access to all your water and CAB Services billing information.

sources.text: Login to your Sterling Ranch Utility account at https://ebill.sterlingranchco.com/ubs1/ to: Pay your bill or setup an automatic payment Review your 12-month usage summary Understand your gallon consumption by month and year If you are having trouble locating your account number or need a copy of your bill please email info@sterlingranchcab.com Quarterly Assessment Bill: The quarterly CAB Service Fees are billed on a quarterly basis and are administered by Capital Consultants Management Corporation ( CCMC ). Quarterly CAB Service Fees include stormwater, trash and recycling, streetlights, and driveway maintenance (Lennar Elements homes only). Payment options are listed below. Direct-Debit The direct-debit payment option is available at no charge. If you are set up for direct-debit and your assessment has changed, the new amount will automatically be deducted. Download and complete the direct debit authorization form. Electronic Checks & Credit Card Payments To pay by Credit Card or Electronic, visit the Smartstreet Website . There is a $14.95 processing fee per credit card transaction. There is no charge for electronic check transactions. American Express, Discover, Mastercard, and Visa are accepted. Recurring credit card payments with Smartstreet are valid for one year or when your credit card expires, whichever is sooner. At that time, you must renew your payment with Smartstreet, it does not happen automatically. If you have recurring payments with Smartstreet and your assessment amount changes, you must update your payment information with Smartstreet as it doesn’t happen automatically. Bill-Payment Services If you use a bill-payment service please review your account number and payment mailing address.

sources.text: If you haven’t signed up to get access to the Overlook Clubhouse, complete the Resident Amenity Form online today! **For homeowners who registered for the Overlook Clubhouse prior to its opening in October 2020 should have received the email to complete account setup already. If you have not received the email or your link is expired, please contact the Overlook Clubhouse at 720-728-7257 or email recreation@sterlingranchcab.com and a staff member will assist you.** This account and password are for the new CIVICREC system and will be used for registering for events, reserving time to use the fitness center, purchasing fitness classes, additional guest passes, and more! Follow the instructions listed below to complete your account setup. How to Finish Your Online Account Setup Open the email. You will have a username (your email provided) and a temporary password to log in. Select TO LOGIN AND CHANGE YOUR PASSWORD NOW CLICK HERE. You will be redirected to the new CIVICREC Website. Once logged in, select ACCOUNT in the top lefthand corner. Select the pencil icon next to your name. In the lower-left corner, select RESET CIVICREC PASSWORD. You will be prompted to confirm that you would like to reset the password. A password reset link will be sent to your email. Follow the instructions to reset your password. Registering for Events & Programs Navigate to the Community Calendar . Click on the event that interests you. Click "More Details" to view the full event description, event cost, suggested ages, and registration links. Review the event details and confirm if an RSVP or program registration is required. If required, a link to register on the right-hand column will say "Register Now" Follow the registration prompts.

Home - FAQs How do I trouble shoot your water meter when you have no water? Valves - Gen 1 These valves require the smart home system to be online and functioning to open and close the valves. To troubleshoot we recommend the following: Make sure the smart home system is online; if not, use https://lumiere.technology/knowledge-base/category/STEWARD/ Submit a ticket with our team at https://lumiere.technology/open-a-ticket/ Water Valves - Gen 2 These valves can easily be opened and closed manually. To troubleshoot, we recommend the following: Click the blue power button on the Dome Valve 1 time. 1 click will cause the arm to turn and open the water supply (see Gen 2 Valves #2 for that power button) If this button does not cause the arm to turn, pull the silver pin on the device and manually move the arm (see Gen 2 Valves #3 for that pin) For additional help submit a ticket at https://lumiere.technology/open-a-ticket/ Home - FAQs Home - FAQs 6 How do I submit an application for Design Review? sources.title: STEWARD Home Automation System
sources.text: STEWARD Home Automation System STEWARD is your Smart Home Automation System and tightly integrated with all your other in-home devices. It’s an all-in-one home automation, home security, and utility monitoring system that came standard with your new Sterling Ranch home. STEWARD works with voice control, smart thermostats, door locks, garage doors, security cameras, and more. Standard Features Real-time, hourly & monthly reporting of your natural gas, electric & water usage A Rachio smart irrigation controller configured to water your lawn efficiently A DSC home security system that is connected to the STEWARD system Automated lighting and HVAC controls Connection to the Sterling Ranch Community to keep you informed about what’s happening around the neighborhood!
